title: Multifunctional additives with dynamic sacrificial S–S bonds for building self-assembled monolayers of Zn-ion batteries with improved stability and longevity
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4186-4199
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05922K, Paper
Shuang Han, Minghai Li, Qiyu Fan, Zhuoyi Han, Xuewen Ming, Wen Wang, Wanan Cai, Haijun Niu
The BHED additive optimizing the Zn2+ solvation structure and in situ building the β-ME SAM with highly active zincophilic sites on the Zn anode surface, Zn-ion batteries exhibit excellent interfacial stability, cyclic reversibility, and longevity.
